abstract: Building on recent advances in AI-driven text mining, this study applies a theory-guided text analytics approach based on the Large Language Model LLaMA to examine customer satisfaction in food delivery platform ecosystems. Using Uber EATS customer reviews, the study employs Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting to derive constructs grounded in the European Customer Satisfaction Index (ECSI) and interprets them through a Service-Dominant Logic lens. The research proceeds in two stages: measurement validation and structural modelling of relationships among constructs. Study 1 indicates that perceived quality is most strongly associated with overall satisfaction, with service quality contributing more strongly than food quality. This supports SDL’s emphasis on value-in-use emerging from integrated service performance. While overall satisfaction reflects a holistic evaluation of the platform ecosystem, confirmation of expectations is more closely related to transactional fairness. Study 2 indicates that platform image functions primarily as a loyalty-shaping resource. Moreover, overall satisfaction is more strongly associated with customer trust and loyalty than with reductions in complaint behaviour, suggesting that dissatisfaction may not always translate into observable complaint behaviour and may instead reflect unexpressed customer disengagement in low-switching-cost food delivery markets. Overall, the findings support the applicability of the ECSI framework within platform ecosystems and indicate that overall satisfaction is shaped by coordinated value co-creation among platforms, restaurants, and independent delivery providers. This study extends customer satisfaction research to platform-based services and demonstrates how AI-enabled text analytics can support theory-consistent empirical analysis of unstructured customer feedback.

ur.tldr: 研究如何利用大语言模型解码平台型外卖服务中顾客声音以评估满意度。基于在线评论等顾客生成文本，采用LLM进行情感与满意度分析，识别影响顾客满意的关键因素，验证LLM在海量反馈文本理解中的有效性，为餐饮平台改进服务提供数据支持。

title: Decoding customer voices using large language models: assessing customer satisfaction in platform-based food delivery services
title_zh: 利用大语言模型解读客户声音：平台型外卖服务中客户满意度的评估
